# mtncloud_users (Data Source)

Lists your users, including those made in the console. Users of your tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_users" "all" {}

output "users" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_users.all.users : x.username => x.username }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Only list users whose `enabled` is this.
- `name_regex` (String) Only return users whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `roles` (List of String) Only list users that have every one of these `roles` (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `account_locked` (Boolean) Whether the account is locked.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) ID of the user.
- `last_login_date` (String) Last login (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `password_expired` (Boolean) Whether the password has expired.
- `roles` (List of String) Names of the user's roles.
- `username` (String) Name of the user.
